## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `89e65abb467ab6061f963b84bb215bf8d02b8f91`
Local-runs: none
Security-touching: yes

PR #37511 (card #37327), declaration face. Read: card #37327 with its five comments (os-dev report 7188670345, claim amendment 7188713030), cards #36871 and #37326, the PR body, the net diff against `main` (6 files, +522/−60) and the head's check-runs (39 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed). Code outside the diff was read to judge the diff, never reviewed. Nothing was built or run, so every behaviour below is read from code unless a check-run or a pin in the diff is named.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public surface
- No authorable key, accepted value or metadata type moves. `laneCounts` is a React prop on `KanbanBoardProps` / `KanbanBoardCoreProps`, supplied only by `ObjectKanban`; `KanbanRenderer` does not forward it, so no schema can carry it. RIGHT.
- `compileLaneReadQuery`, `LANE_COUNT_ALIAS`, `readLaneCounts`, `readLaneKeys`, `LaneReadQueryInput`, `LaneReading` and `LaneFigureReading.alias` are module exports of `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`; the package root (`src/index.tsx`) re-exports none of them. No published export is added. RIGHT.
- `compileLaneStatisticQuery` delegates and compiles the same query as before for a statistic-only read (statistic first, the `avg` weight second, same refusal when an alias equals the lane field). A board that queries its own cards is unchanged: without `hostLaneRead` the read asks nothing new, and the new `objectDefReady` gate was already implied by `statisticFieldDrawable`. RIGHT.

Scope of the figures (judge item 1)
- Filter and search: the count, the total and the lane keys ride the one #36871 read, compiled from the node's `filter` (ListView's `selfQueryFilter`, the effective filter of the page's own fetch) and the host's search pair, re-asked on the host's `reloadKey` (refresh button, `refreshTrigger`, invalidation bus, and `onMutation` through `refreshKey`). Same scope as the cards. RIGHT. A filter that does not lower compiles to no read, and the figures fall back to page figures marked `+`. RIGHT.
- Permission scope: the read goes through `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders`, which posts to `POST /data/:object/query` and reaches `engine.aggregate` inside the read middleware chain (row scope of sharing and row rules; refusal of an aggregate over a field the reader may not read). The adapter has no client-side fallback for this door. A count therefore covers only records the reader can read. RIGHT, on the strength of code outside the diff that was read and not run.
- The header total is asked only where the header draws it (`summarizeTotalDrawable`, the old inline gate moved unchanged, including `perms.checkField`). While permissions are not loaded the client may ask the SUM and the server refuses it; the refusal empties counts, totals and keys together, so the board falls back to marked page figures. Fail-closed. RIGHT (see N4).
- Sums: an all-null lane sums to 0 on both paths; a numeric string reads as its number (`numberOf`); mixed currency codes are added as bare numbers exactly as the page path (`sumLaneField`) adds them. Parity with main, with one exception, S4.
- Lane mapping: a group key maps through `laneKeyOf`, the function that keys a card. The empty and null groups fold into the trailing lane's id for counts and totals and are left out of `readLaneKeys`. A fixed-lane board folds unknown keys into the trailing lane, as before. RIGHT for a reference lane field. Not established for other option-less lane fields, S2.
- Referenced records the reader cannot read, or that are deleted: the title read is an ordinary `find` on the target object (row-scoped), so such a record returns no row and its lane is titled by its raw key, which the reader already holds on the readable deal. No title, and no figure over unreadable records, is revealed. RIGHT. A raw id as a lane title is a wart, N5.

One read per board (judge item 2)
- The COUNT and the SUM are aggregations added to the one grouped statement; no row or id of the laned object is materialised in the app. RIGHT. The declared cost (a board with no lane statistic now asks that one grouped COUNT) is ACCEPTABLE and should not be skipped: the count badge is drawn on every such board, and without the read every badge is a page figure.

The fallback (judge item 3)
- `+` is never missing where the read gave no whole figure: pending, no door, refusal, partial answer (`hasMore`), an uncompilable read, and a lane that draws cards the answer did not count all write the page figure marked. RIGHT.
- `+` is over-written in one case: with no usable read the board cannot tell a whole page from a cut one, so a lane whose every record is on the page reads `10+` where main read `10`. True as a floor, less exact than main, N1.
- Stale whole figures: after a drag the old answer stays on screen, unmarked, until the re-asked read lands (`Math.max(cards, count)` only raises a count that fell below the cards drawn). The re-ask is driven by `onMutation` through the host's `reloadKey`; a source without `onMutation` keeps the old count until a manual refresh. N2.

Tests
- The three pins and three controls of the card's Done-when are in the rig and `Test UI` is green on the head; the three ablations are reported red and restored. Done-when is MET. The rig's `queryGroupHeaders` is hand-written, so the real door is not exercised by it; the field-less `count` aggregation is a declared shape of the spec's aggregation node, so the risk is a refusal that lands on the marked fallback. Claimed behaviours without a pin: S3.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/37327-kanban-lookup-lane-whole-counts.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` patch. A bug fix in a released package with no protocol change takes `patch`. RIGHT. The other package in the diff (`app-shell`) changes a test file only and publishes nothing. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- Clause-②: no — carried in the PR body and the changeset body, and it holds: no accept set and no published export moves.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — holds: nothing an author can write changes.
- Changeset wording, N3: it says "lanes over a lookup field" where the code covers every option-less lane field, and "the trailing Uncategorized lane is unchanged" where its count and total, when the lane is drawn, now read the whole lane.

### ③ Boundary flags

Findings

S1 (should-fix) — A lane drawn from the read with no card on the page prints the `kanban.noCards` placeholder ("No cards") under a count badge of 10 (`KanbanImpl.tsx`, `safeCards.length === 0 && !suppressEmptyPlaceholder`; the board is not empty, so the placeholder is not suppressed). Reachability is not a regression: on main those records were not on the board at all, and every lane already counts more than it draws with no per-lane paging on this board. The contradicting sentence is new with this PR. Fix here (suppress or reword the placeholder when the whole count exceeds the cards drawn) or carry it on the card S5 asks for.

S2 (should-fix) — Past-page lanes are drawn for every lane field without options, not only a lookup: `ListView` hands a page whenever the lane field has no options (text, number, boolean, date, a person field), and `extraLaneIds` is gated on `lanesFromData` alone. The feature rests on a group key of the aggregate spelling a value exactly as a `find` row does. That is pinned for a lookup only. Where the two spellings differ (a boolean answered as 1/0 by a driver, a date or datetime, a number), the page's lanes fall to marked page counts AND a second, empty lane is drawn per value with a whole count. On main the same mismatch drew nothing extra. Not measured. Either gate the past-page lanes on a reference lane field (`laneTargetObject`), or pin a non-reference type, or draw no extra lane when a lane on the page went uncounted (the answer and the page then disagree on keys).

S3 (should-fix) — The changeset and the docblocks claim the fallback for a refused read and for a cut answer, and that the count read carries the filter and the search pair; the diff pins only the no-door control. `readLaneCounts` and `readLaneKeys` (both new, both with a `hasMore` branch) have no unit pin, and nothing pins the trailing lane's whole count or the `where` / `search` of the count read. Add pins for refusal, `hasMore`, and the scope of the read.

S4 (should-fix) — The whole-lane header total skips the rounding the page path applies. `sumLaneField` rounds to the widest input's decimals so a `number` field with no `scale` never prints a binary residue; the new path hands `renderTotal` the server's SUM (and, for the trailing lane, a JS sum of several groups' sums through `foldParts`) unrounded. A float-backed column can then print a residue in the header where main printed a clean figure. Not measured. The #36871 foot `sum` has the same exposure; fix both or file it.

S5 (should-fix) — Three gaps are reported and none is carried by a card that covers it. (a) The trailing Uncategorized lane is not drawn when every empty-lookup record sits past page one: its records then appear in no lane, and the lane counts do not add up to the list footer's total. Predates the PR; needs a card. (b) A lane with a whole count and no way to load its cards (S1): needs a card for per-lane loading or an explicit "N more not shown" on the hosted board. (c) The swimlane layout of the same board still writes page counts unmarked. The PR and the report name #37326 as its carrier, but #37326 is about the missing lane-foot statistic in swimlanes, not about page counts, so this one is uncarried. File (a), (b) and (c), or widen #37326 in writing, before this lands.

S6 (should-fix) — SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5). The lane titles are an in-app join: the group keys are materialised in the browser and sent back as `id IN (…)` to the target object, with no reason given in the PR. A reason exists and should be stated: the public door refuses a dotted `groupBy`, the relation-group join is engine-internal, so the title cannot ride the one aggregate over the wire. The list is bounded (a cut answer names no extra lane, so it never exceeds one group page), and the read runs only when a past-page lane exists. The read asks no `$select`, so it fetches every field of each referenced record to draw one title; project the id and the title fields.

N1 (nit) — `+` over-marks a whole page when no read answers (above). The host knows its total and could say the page is whole.
N2 (nit) — Whole figures are held unmarked while the re-asked read is in flight, and indefinitely on a source without `onMutation`.
N3 (nit) — Changeset wording (see ②).
N4 (nit) — One refused aggregation (an unreadable `summarizeField` with no permission provider loaded) takes the counts and the past-page lanes down with it, though a count-only read would answer. Also `LANE_COUNT_ALIAS = 'count'`: on a hosted board a lane field named `count` now compiles to no read at all, which also removes the #36871 statistic that read used to answer.
N5 (nit) — A past-page lane is titled by its raw key when the referenced record is unreadable or deleted, and always for a person field that names no `reference` (no title read is made). The extra lanes follow the aggregate's row order, which the read does not sort, so their order may move between refreshes.

Dev flags and open questions
- `open_questions`: none in the report.
- `security_findings`: none in the report, and this review found none. The security line above reads yes because the diff changes which permission-gated reads the client issues and draws (a per-lane COUNT, a SUM, lane keys past the page, a read of referenced records) and moves the field-read gate of the header total; the scoping itself is the server's and was read, not run. That is a statement about the diff's class, not a finding.
- Deviation, file surface: the dev edited `ObjectKanban.tsx` and `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts` outside the claimed surface and the claim was amended after the fact (7188713030, after the report). The amendment's facts hold against the diff: #36871's read lives in those two files, `ListView.tsx` is untouched, `KanbanColumnSummary.ts` is untouched. Whether an after-the-fact amendment is accepted where the claim said to stop on breach is the seat's call. ESCALATED to the seat.
- Deviation, one merge of `origin/main` before the PR opened: the head is that merge commit and the check-runs are on it. ANSWERED.
- Out-of-scope findings (three): answered in S5.
- Sibling #37326 waits on this PR for `KanbanImpl.tsx`; nothing in this diff pre-empts its product choice. ANSWERED.
- Independence: implementer and reviewer are different sessions of the same account and seat; the seat checks the pair before adopting this record.
- The PR is still a draft.

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `89e65abb467ab6061f963b84bb215bf8d02b8f91`
**REWORK** — L1, seat repo:objectstack#5. Contract record 7188888406 reads **PASS**, with no must-fix and six should-fix items open.

The core holds:
- counts and sums use the page's own filter and search;
- the grouped read goes through the row-scoped aggregate door with no client fallback, so no count covers records the user cannot read;
- COUNT and SUM ride one grouped statement.

1. **Shape**: open draft against `main`, 6 files (+522/−60), `Fixes #37327`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch. Not governed. 39 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed.
2. **Premise**: whole-lane counts and totals on a kanban laned by a lookup. Lanes whose records all sit past page one are drawn from the read's group keys.
3. **Owed before ACCEPT** (in this PR):
   - **S1.** A past-page lane shows "No cards" under a count of 10. Replace the placeholder for a lane whose count exceeds its loaded cards, for example "10 cards not loaded". Loading them is S5's card.
   - **S2.** Past-page lanes are drawn for every option-less lane field (text, boolean, date, number, person), not only lookups. Do one of these:
     - restrict the past-page lanes to lookup fields, as the card and changeset say; or
     - normalise group keys against `find` rows, and pin a non-lookup case.
   - **S3.** Add pins for the refused read, the cut answer (`hasMore`), `readLaneCounts` / `readLaneKeys`, and the filter and search scope of the count read.
   - **S4.** The whole-lane header total skips `sumLaneField`'s rounding. Apply the same rounding and pin it with a float-backed `number` field.
   - **S6.** Give the lane-title read a `$select` of id plus the display field. State in a code comment why it is an `id IN (…)` read: the public door refuses a dotted `groupBy`, and the list is bounded.
   - **N3.** Fix the changeset wording: "lookup field" if S2 restricts, and the Uncategorized count.
4. **Cards owed** (S5), under #37327, with their numbers in the PR body:
   - (a) the Uncategorized lane is not drawn when every empty-lookup record is past page one;
   - (b) loading the cards of a past-page lane;
   - (c) swimlane page counts. #37326 covers only the lane-foot statistic, so either widen #37326 or file a card.
5. **Accepted deviations** (nits):
   - N1: "+" over-marks a fully-loaded lane when no read is usable.
   - N2: whole counts stay unmarked while the re-ask after a drag is in flight.
   - N4: one refused aggregate drops counts and extra lanes, and a lane field named `count` compiles to no read. Carry it on S5's card if not fixed.
   - N5: raw-id titles for unreadable or deleted references; the extra-lane order.
   - The seat accepts the after-the-fact fence amendment 7188713030. Its facts hold against the diff, and both files are in the same package.
6. **Landing terms**: ungoverned, default tier. Owed: S1–S4, S6 and N3 closed, S5 carried, required contexts green, a same-head delta PASS and an **ACCEPT**. Then the maintainer names it for landing, because o5-U's auto mode refuses `--land`. `Security-touching: yes` per the record (no finding), so the `security` label goes on at ACCEPT.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `866e4bd1bb91630da55c5f457ff19b19f7fa3bde`
Local-runs: none
Security-touching: yes

Delta round for PR #37511 (card #37327), declaration face, on top of record 7188888406 (head `89e65abb46`, PASS with S1 to S6 and N1 to N5) and the seat's REWORK 7188910951. Read: the os-dev report 7191098504, claim amendment 7191127877, the PR body, the delta from `89e65abb46` (3 commits, 18 files, +216/−18), the net diff against `main` (19 files, +724/−64), cards #37516 and #37517, the widening comment 7188972467 on #37326, and the head's check-runs (62 runs: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed). The tree was judged, not the report. Nothing was built or run; behaviour is read from code unless a check-run or a pin in the diff is named.

### ① Derived judgments

Earlier findings
- S1 — CLOSED. A lane with no card on the page and a whole count above zero prints `kanban.notLoaded` ("Cards not loaded: 10") in place of `kanban.noCards` (`KanbanImpl.tsx`, `notLoaded`: no cards, a whole count that is not a floor, above zero). Pinned in the rig, with the "No cards" text asserted absent. The condition is on the count alone, so a declared lane on a hosted board gets the same honest line. RIGHT.
- S2 — CLOSED by restriction. `extraLaneIds` now also requires `laneTargetObject`, so only a lane field that names the object it references draws lanes past the page; a text, number, boolean or date field, and a person field with no `reference`, draw the page's lanes only and keep whole counts where keys match, marked page figures where they do not. Pinned on a text-laned board (30/30, no `bronze` lane). RIGHT.
- S3 — CLOSED. The rig pins a refused read and a cut read (`hasMore`): marked counts, marked header totals, no lane past the page. It pins the count under the view's filter (25/25/10, `where` present). The plugin suite pins a count-only read's `where`, `search` and `searchFields`, and unit-pins `readLaneCounts` (folding the null and empty groups into the trailing lane, `null` on a cut answer or a non-number) and `readLaneKeys` (order, once each, by foreign key, `null` on a cut answer). `Test UI` is green on the head.
- S4 — CLOSED. `foldParts` returns a `sum` through `withoutBinaryResidue` (15 significant digits), which covers the header total, the foot `sum` of #36871 and #36520, and a fold of several groups. Pinned by unit (0.1 + 0.2, and a three-group fold) and in the rig (a float header total of `0.3`). The changeset states the foot `sum` change. See N6.
- S5 — CLOSED as carried. #37516 (Uncategorized lane past page one) and #37517 (loading a past-page lane's cards) are open under #37327, and #37326 is widened in writing (7188972467) to swimlane page counts. The PR body lists all three.
- S6 — CLOSED. A code comment states why the title read is an `id IN (…)` read beside the aggregate (the public door refuses a dotted `groupBy`; the list is at most one page of groups; the read runs only when a past-page lane exists), and the read projects `id` plus the title fields. Pinned in the rig as one read with `$select: ['id', 'name']`. See N7.
- N3 — CLOSED. The changeset now says "lanes from the data" for counts and totals, "lookup" for past-page lanes, and states the trailing lane's whole count and what stays unchanged.
- N1, N2, N4, N5 — OPEN, accepted by the seat as deviations (7188910951) and listed in the PR body. Unchanged in the tree. One addition to N2: when the last page card of a lane is dragged out, the held count makes the lane read "Cards not loaded: N" until the re-asked read lands.

Public surface in the delta
- `@object-ui/i18n`: every one of the eleven packs gains `kanban.notLoaded`. `TranslationKeys` is `typeof en` and is exported from the package entry with the `en` pack, so the published surface gains one member. WRONGLY DECLARED, S7.
- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: `withoutBinaryResidue` is a module export of `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`, not re-exported from the package root. No published export is added. RIGHT.
- No authorable key, accepted value or metadata type moves. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. Both levels are RIGHT: a bug fix, and one added language-pack key, with `Metadata-protocol: none`; AGENTS.md ships a non-protocol widening as `patch`. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- Clause-②: no — WRONG for this head, S7. It held on `89e65abb46`; the delta adds a key to the published packs.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — holds.
- The new key itself: `kanban.notLoaded` sits beside `kanban.noCards` in all eleven packs, reads "Label: N" in each, and is listed under `COUNT_NEUTRAL.tally` in `count-families-11445.test.ts` with its reason, the same treatment as the neighbouring "Label: N" keys. `KanbanImpl.tsx` carries the English default, so a host on an older pack degrades to English, never to a raw key. RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

New findings

S7 (should-fix) — The declaration line is wrong on this head. The PR body and the changeset both read `Clause-②: no`, and the delta widens a published surface: `kanban.notLoaded` is a new member of the exported `en` pack and of the exported `TranslationKeys` type. The repo's own precedent declares exactly this as a widening: the pending changesets that add `@object-ui/i18n` keys carry `Clause-②: yes (widening)` naming the key (for example "one new published language-pack key, view.savedOutsideApp, in all eleven packs"), and the i18n CHANGELOG gives the reason in those words. One pending changeset (`35730`) declares `no` with a new key, so the practice is not uniform; if the seat holds that reading it should say so on the card. Otherwise: change both lines to `Clause-②: yes (widening)` naming `kanban.notLoaded` and "nothing removed", and amend the claim, since the dev copies the claim's line. The level stays `patch`.

N6 (nit) — `withoutBinaryResidue` rounds to 15 significant digits, and its comment says no stored digit is dropped. A non-integer sum with more than 15 significant digits (ten trillion and above with two decimals) loses its last digit, where the page path's `toFixed` kept it. Out of practical reach; correct the comment or carry it.

N7 (nit) — The projection can change a title in one case and the read can run twice. `referencedTitleFields` selects the `displayField` and the declared-or-derived name field; when a record's declared name field is empty, the ladder's later rungs (the derived field, the name-like keys) are no longer fetched and the lane falls to its raw key. And the effect depends on `laneTargetDef` without waiting for its `ready`: if the grouped read answers before the target's definition, an unprojected read goes out first and a projected one follows. The rig settles the definition first, so its one-read pin does not see this.

N8 (nit) — The PR body is stale in three places: "What changes" still lists the changeset as `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` alone and the board as "lanes over a lookup field", and the closing line counts 45 success and 13 skipped where the head has 47 and 15.

SQL push-down (the standing check)
- Unchanged from the earlier record and now reasoned in code: the COUNT and the SUM ride one grouped statement, nothing of the laned object is materialised in the app, and the one id list (lane titles) cannot be pushed down over the public door, is bounded, and is projected. No finding.

The fence amendment (7191127877)
- The eleven locale packs and `count-families-11445.test.ts` are IN SCOPE. The seat's S1 asked for a user-visible sentence; a user-visible sentence is a language-pack key in every pack, and the count-family test fails for any `{{count}}` key that is neither a family nor listed (the intermediate head `dda780f721` was red on exactly that, by the report). Both are the smallest change S1 implies, in files that carry nothing else from this PR (one line per pack, three lines in the test).
- It is again recorded after the fact, the second time on this card. The first was the seat's to accept and it did; this one follows from the seat's own rework order. ESCALATED to the seat as before, with no objection from this review. The report says #37436 and #37422 share the locale files and merge cleanly; that was not checked here.

Dev flags and open questions
- `open_questions`: none in the report.
- `security_findings`: none in the report, and this review found none. The security line above stays yes for the reason the earlier record gave: the diff changes which permission-gated reads the client issues and draws. The delta narrows one of them (the title read now projects two fields) and adds none.
- Deviation, PR body patched by the dev through the relay on the rework order: the seat's order, ANSWERED there.
- Deviation, an unquoted heredoc started an unlocked vitest run for about two minutes: stopped, tree reported clean, no file of the diff affected. ANSWERED; the seat may want it on the round report.
- Out-of-scope findings: all three carried (S5).
- Independence: implementer and reviewer are different sessions of the same account and seat, as before.
- The PR is still a draft.
